title: UX x AI Source Item
description: A single unit of source material (talk, episode, article, conference session, or thought-leader stance) used as input for course generation.

id.description: Stable kebab-case slug, prefixed by type (e.g. 'yt-config-2024-feifei-li').

url.description: Primary canonical URL for the item.

date.description: ISO-8601 date string. May be year-only ('2024') or year-month ('2024-08') or full ('2024-08-12'). Pair with date_precision.

date_precision.description: How precisely the date is known. 'approximate' means rough season/year only.

publisher.description: Channel, podcast name, publication, or conference.

duration_minutes.description: Approximate runtime in minutes for audio/video items.

themes.description: Canonical theme tag IDs from themes_taxonomy.json. Use for retrieval.

raw_themes.description: Original free-text theme strings as written in the source markdown, kept for traceability.

summary.description: 1-3 sentence editorial summary. May be the source's own thesis line.

stance_tags.description: Camp/posture tags useful for balancing course modules across viewpoints.

source_quality.description: Editorial substance rating, not popularity. 'high' = primary, well-developed argument; 'medium' = solid but secondary; 'low' = passing mention or thin source.

verified.description: Whether URL and date have been hand-checked. Defaults to false after ingest.

raw_excerpt.description: The raw markdown rows or block this item was parsed from, for traceability.

source_file.description: Which research/*.md the item came from.
